scope: Exactly 8 original MNG contacts and 1 Sumy contact, 9 mapped-land cells; no other disposition.

MNG.source: Authenticated complete 22-feature OSM/Wambacher ADM1 family, represented as 2017, source-information update 2023-01-19, build 2023-12-12, ODbL. Actual four held-contact feature properties were inspected; IDs are geoBoundaries IDs, not recovered OSM object IDs.
MNG.research: Examined the 2002 Mongolian approval act and actual official one-page PDF export; it approves 1987–2001 inspection documents and line changes and identifies map/marker/coordinate records absent from the inspected publication route. Examined the 2007 ratification act and official portal access limits. Classified actual WFS disabled response against documented service contract, kept it stopped, and used the independently advertised public WMS to obtain four actual rasters and one identified bilateral boundary feature.
MNG.comparison: All 8 original MNG source geometries and mapped-land support cover their respective centers. Existing whole-target physical issues remain distinct; the two Erzinsky issue geometries do not cover its center, which is not a full-cell clearance claim. The actual MNG/RUS feature gives distances approximately 11.9–313.8 m, not a side assignment or accuracy threshold.
MNG.why_unresolved: Available source-specific evidence does not justify removing the original negative contact or assigning a new RUS repair. The exact approved map/coordinate entries would be material, but no accessible locator was found in examined official routes. This is substantial performed investigation with a bounded remaining evidence gap, not an inference from WFS unavailability or generic modern authority.

Sumy.source: Retained 2017 OSM/Wambacher Sumy ADM1 contact remains intact. The original source role was examined against primary oblast identity records and actual Treaty I-54132 text/map.
Sumy.research: Examined actual treaty PDF and exact map bundle rather than stopping at web size limits. Read route 244–246, inspected map labels, corrected projection zone and datum treatment, traced actual canal/straight route and recorded alternatives. The independent reviewer read the source text and actual pixels.
Sumy.finding: Under explicit conditional zone 6 / Pulkovo 1942 interpretation, the key is about 0.55–0.60 km south of the traced route, on the map-labeled Ukraine side. This is adverse historical source context, not current sovereignty. Exact datum realization, approximate frame controls and non-statistical grid screen remain limitations.
Sumy.why_unresolved: The retained source contact and actual adverse treaty-map join do not support treating this key as an unambiguous RUS repair. Independent assessment finds no identified accessible primary record still required for researched-unresolved disposition; a positive repair would require source-specific resolution. The four other non-robust Sumy placements are excluded.

contract: Preserve all original keys, source competitors, rights/vintages, source-role and physical/native distinctions; #2302 permits an explicitly unresolved outcome after significant research. No universal current-boundary certificate or numerical accuracy threshold is imposed.

scientific_execution_reuse.truth: No new stock observer, physical producer, diagnostic or constructor. Bounded new source/raster comparisons are explicitly identified.
